SafeBand SB-01 Smart Safety Wristband for Outdoor Construction Workers | Heat-Exposure Awareness, SOS Assistance, Hydration Reminders & Supervisor Connect (Concept)

Designed for UAE outdoor work environments, SafeBand proposes personal heat-exposure awareness and a simple way to request help, alongside existing worksite safety procedures.

About this item
  • Heat-awareness alerts: proposed on-screen and vibration warnings to encourage cooling breaks and hydration. Accuracy is not validated.
  • Dedicated SOS button: intended to send an assistance request to a supervisor in a future connected version.
  • Supervisor Connect: proposed dashboard showing team status and simulated incident alerts.
  • Outdoor-oriented design: rugged appearance; actual durability, fit, water resistance, and snagging safety have not been tested.
  • Complements existing safety: does not replace TWL monitoring, breaks, drinking water, PPE, or medical assistance.

Explore the SafeBand concept

🦺 Designed around real construction-site interviews

Interviewees described existing TWL meters, drinking water, ORS, rest areas, safety training, and supervisor support. Some also reported heat-related dizziness or collapse. One worker raised concerns about wristbands catching on equipment. This MVP explores whether personal alerts and an SOS workflow add value, while making those adoption and safety concerns visible.

What remains unproven: sensor accuracy, heat-risk prediction, emergency connectivity, GPS reliability, comfort, snagging safety, regulatory approval, and employers' willingness to pay.

Questions & answers

Can I buy SafeBand here?

No. This is a university MVP simulation. The buttons demonstrate an online shopping flow, not a real purchase.

Does SafeBand actually detect heatstroke?

No such capability has been demonstrated. SafeBand is a proposed warning and assistance concept, not a medical diagnostic or guaranteed prevention device.

Is the product safe to wear around construction equipment?

Not yet established. Snagging hazards, job-specific PPE rules, and safe attachment design would need assessment before real-world use.

What is the proposed business model?

AED 199 per wristband, plus AED 20 monthly per active band for the connected supervisor service. These prices have not been validated by confirmed purchases.
